entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for an order.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your order number please?
Look, is it possible to do this or not? I just need a yes or no. I have an Aero Race jersey, I need to send it back.
Yes, it's generally possible. I just need the order number to confirm the details. What specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. It's just way too tight. The order number is VF88721.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered 17 days ago. That's perfectly within our 90-day return window, so we can definitely process this for you.
Good. So you'll email me a label?
Absolutely. Since the issue is just the size, would you prefer a refund or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
An exchange is fine. Just send the next size up.

Perfect. I have processed the exchange. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just send the original jersey back, and we'll ship the new size. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
